name: Ship Healthcare Holdings, Inc.
summary: Ship Healthcare Holdings, Inc. engages in the medical, healthcare, welfare, and nursing care businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Total Pack Produce Business, Medical Supply Business, Lifecare Business, and Dispensing Pharmacy Business. The Total Pack Produce segment sells medical devices and medical equipment based on bulk orders, as well as physicochemical; offers consulting services on medicine, healthcare, welfare, and nursing care facilities; operates veterinary hospitals; develops, sells, and maintains medical information systems; builds management business; and leases real estate to medical facilities and other tenants.
